verdict: Teh tarik is lower in calories than Milo ais. Milo ais is still fine, just better as an occasional drink.
why: Milo ais is about 200 kcal a glass, teh tarik around 120 kcal. A difference of 80 kcal.
Milo ais has slightly more protein (5 g vs 3 g), but it's still too little to keep you full.
Fat is almost the same (5 g vs 4 g). Most of the calorie difference comes from sugar and condensed milk.
Milo ais is cold and sweet, easy to finish in a few minutes and makes you want to order another.
when_a: Milo ais is okay as an occasional drink, or ask for kurang manis (less sweet) in a regular size.
when_b: Teh tarik suits you when you want a lighter milky drink while you lepak.
tip: Ask for Milo ais kurang manis (less sweet) or 'Milo kosong ais' (iced Milo with no sugar) with a little milk. You still get the chocolate taste, with less sugar.

faq.q: Doesn't Milo ais have protein and give good energy?
faq.a: It has a little protein, but most of the calories come from sugar. To stay full, protein from food like eggs or chicken works better.
The extra powder on top adds even more calories. Treat it as a dessert, not a regular drink.
